definition_zh: 证明；证实；作证；表明；是……的证据
definition_en: to provide clear evidence or testimony that something is true or real
core_image: 证人举手起誓：亲手写下的话为事实盖章
scene: 法庭上一片安静，老工匠握着当年的账本缓缓起立。The old ledger will attest that the bridge was paid for in full.
sceneCN: 这里 attest 是「证明、证实」（第 1 个义项：以证据或证言确认事实为真）；句意为旧账本将证明大桥的款项已全部付清。

derivatives.zh: attest 加名词后缀 -ation，义为「证明；证词；见证签署」
attest 加施动者后缀 -or，义为「证明者；证人」
过去分词转形容词，义为「经证明的；有实据的」
同根词 testis（证人）+ -fy，义为「作证」

senses.title: To give evidence that something is true
senses.definition: to provide clear evidence or a statement that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 提供明确的证据或陈述，确认某事属实
senses.example: The ruins attest the city's former wealth.
senses.exampleCN: 这些废墟证明了这座城市昔日的富庶。
senses.why: The image of standing as a witness grows into proving a fact with evidence.
senses.whyCN: 「作为证人站出来」的画面，引申为用证据把事实立起来。

senses.title: To serve as clear proof of something
senses.definition: to be clear evidence that something exists or is the case
senses.definitionCN: 本身成为某事存在或成立的明证
senses.example: Her calm smile attests her confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她从容的微笑显示出她的自信。
senses.why: If a person stands as witness, things too can stand and speak for a truth.
senses.whyCN: 人可以作证，事物同样能「站立」出来替某个事实说话。

senses.title: To state formally as a witness
senses.definition: to declare formally, especially under oath, that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 尤指宣誓后正式声明某事属实
senses.example: Two colleagues attested to his honesty.
senses.exampleCN: 两位同事为他的诚实作证。
senses.why: The courtroom is where the word keeps its oldest duty: to stand and testify.
senses.whyCN: 法庭是这个词保留最古老职责的地方：站出来，为事实作证。

senses.title: To witness the signing of a document
senses.definition: to sign a document as a witness to confirm its validity
senses.definitionCN: 作为见证人在文件上签名，以确认其效力
senses.why: The witness's own signature attaches a seal of truth to the paper.
senses.whyCN: 见证人亲手签名，等于给文件贴上一枚真实性的封印。

senses.title: To affirm the correctness of something
senses.definition: to certify that a copy, account, or statement is accurate
senses.definitionCN: 核验并确认副本、账目或陈述准确无误
senses.example: The auditor attested the figures in the report.
senses.exampleCN: 审计员确认了报告中的数字无误。
senses.why: Standing beside a claim makes it stand on its own: the verifier's nod completes the proof.
senses.whyCN: 核验人站在声明旁边替它撑腰：一点头，证明就完整了。

senses.title: To show or make something evident
senses.definition: to make something clearly apparent, as qualities shown by deeds
senses.definitionCN: 使某事清晰可见，如由行为彰显出的品质
senses.example: Years of quiet work attest his loyalty to the team.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的默默耕耘彰显了他对团队的忠诚。
senses.why: When proof accumulates into a visible pattern, it becomes demonstration.
senses.whyCN: 当证据累积成可见的整体面貌，证明就变成了彰显。

senses.title: To confirm the truth of a claim or report
senses.definition: to support a claim or report by independent confirmation
senses.definitionCN: 以独立的确证支持某个说法或传闻
senses.example: Later digs attested the rumors of an older settlement.
senses.exampleCN: 后来的挖掘证实了关于更古老聚落的传闻。
senses.why: A rumor stands alone until another witness steps up beside it.
senses.whyCN: 传闻孤掌难鸣，直到另一位证人站到它身边。

senses.title: To testify to one's experience or belief
senses.titleCN: 亲证；见证（个人经历、信仰）
senses.definition: to speak from personal experience, especially about one's faith
senses.definitionCN: 以亲身经历发言，尤指分享信仰的见证
senses.example: Survivors attest to the fury of the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 幸存者们见证了那场风暴的狂暴。
senses.why: The witness stands not for facts alone but for what he himself lived through.
senses.whyCN: 证人所站的，不只是事实旁边，还有自己亲身经历过的那一端。

intro.en: Attest comes from Latin attestari, to stand as a witness, built on testis, a witness.
intro.cn: attest 来自拉丁语 attestari（作为证人出席作证），核心是 testis（证人）。

items.en: The root *treys- meant three; the witness as a third, disinterested party is one traditional explanation, though the link is debated.
items.cn: 词根 *treys- 意为「三」；一种传统解释认为证人即「第三方」的中立者，但此说尚有争议。

items.en: Attestari combined ad- (toward) and testari (to call as witness, make a will), from testis (witness).
items.cn: 拉丁语 attestari 由 ad-（朝向）与 testari（召作证人、立遗嘱）构成，词根为 testis（证人）。

items.en: Attester carried the same legal sense of bearing witness.
items.cn: 古法语 attester 沿袭了「作证」的法律含义。

items.en: English adopted attest in legal and religious contexts for formal witnessing.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语借入 attest，用于法律与宗教语境中的正式见证。

items.en: The sense widened from courtroom oaths to any clear evidence in general use.
items.cn: 现代英语中词义从法庭宣誓扩展为泛指一切明确的证据。

note.en: Attest keeps the witness in its root: testis means the third person who stands beside the fact.
note.cn: attest 的词根里始终住着证人：testis 即站在事实旁边的第三方。

entries.definition: the act of attesting; a formal statement of proof
entries.definitionCN: 证明行为；正式证词（同根派生）

entries.definition: to make a statement as a witness in court
to confirm officially, often in writing
to check and confirm the truth of something
to support a statement with further evidence
to prove a claim with evidence
a formal statement of what one witnessed

normalIntro.en: Split it as at-test: the witness steps up to the test of truth.
normalIntro.cn: 拆成 at + test：证人站到真相的考验面前。

normal.cn: 拉丁语 testis 意为证人。

normal.en: at- here is ad-, meaning toward.
normal.cn: 这里的 at- 即 ad-，意为朝向。

normal.en: attest to + fact is the common pattern.
normal.cn: 常见搭配为 attest to + 事实。

abstract.en: Picture a raised right hand in a quiet courtroom.
abstract.cn: 想象安静法庭里举起的右手。

abstract.en: See a seal pressed onto a signed page.
abstract.cn: 看见一枚印章盖在签好的页面上。

abstract.en: Feel a third person standing firmly beside the fact.
abstract.cn: 体会第三个人稳稳站在事实身旁。

examples.en: The fingerprints attest that he entered the room.
examples.cn: 指纹证明他进过那个房间。

examples.en: Thousands of fans attest to the band's lasting appeal.
examples.cn: 成千上万的歌迷证明了这支乐队持久的魅力。

examples.en: Her rapid recovery attested the success of the treatment.
examples.cn: 她迅速的康复证明了治疗的成功。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额太思特」——额在法庭上接受「test（测试）」般严格的质询，为事实作证即 attest。

root: 拉丁语 testis（证人）→ testari（召作证人）→ 加前缀 ad-（朝向）构成 attestari（作为证人出席作证）→ 经古法语 attester 进入英语 attest（证明；作证）。

sensesIntro.en: From the courtroom oath the word widens to every kind of standing proof.
sensesIntro.cn: 从法庭上的誓言出发，这个词扩展为一切「站得住的证据」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a witness standing firmly beside a fact
core.cn: 核心意象：稳稳站在事实旁边的证人

branches.en: personal witness of experience or faith

intro.en: A small prefix ad- pushes the witness root test- toward the fact.
intro.cn: 小小的前缀 ad- 把「证人」词根 test- 推向事实本身。

latinIntro.en: The Latin witness root testis anchors a whole family of proof words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语「证人」词根 testis 支撑着整个「证明」词族。
